We call upon researchers, academics, and postgraduate students from around the globe to submit their research papers and abstracts in alignment with themes of the conference which expects participation from a large number of researchers worldwide. The researcher will be informed of the result of the submitted abstract by the conference’s scientific committee within one week from the date of submission.
